caseNameFull: McGrady v. Smyth, Superintendent, Virginia Penitentiary
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. A. S. Harrison, Attorney General of Virginia, and Thomas M. Miller, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to file petition for writ of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
